traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria in docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md are satisfied: - **Before/After/Mixed JSDoc Tags**: Implemented via `isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine` and `processCommentLine`, and verified by multiple valid test cases. - **Proper Termination & JSDoc Tag Detection**: Non-traceability JSDoc lines (any `@word` except @story/@req/@supports) terminate pending traceability values. - **Continuation Lines & Multi-line Preservation**: Continuation only occurs when a pending annotation exists and the next line does not start with `@`; multi-line story values are preserved without pulling in following tags. - **No False Positives / Clear Errors**: The specific scenario described in the story’s problem context (`REQ-OPTIMIZATION@param{object}data`) is now a passing, non-error case; error messaging is unchanged and remains clear for genuinely invalid formats. - **Documentation & Tests**: Rule docs explicitly describe coexistence semantics and provide examples; Jest tests for all listed requirements are present and passing.
Based on the concrete code, tests, and documentation, this story is fully implemented and stable.
